describe.owner: Full control, including billing and deleting the organisation.
describe.admin: Manages people, roles, settings and all the books.
describe.accountant: Keeps the books: posts journals, closes periods, handles tax.
describe.bookkeeper: Records day-to-day invoices, bills, payments and banking.
describe.auditor: Reads everything and exports reports; changes nothing.
describe.viewer: Sees the main reports and the chart of accounts.
